sheets.title: TITLE SHEET
sheets.reading_notes: Title sheet for record drawings package, dated 28 May 2025. Project is PB00010-2J Renovate Facility B9305, Fort Gregg-Adams, Virginia. Drawing index shows 11 total sheets: G-001, D-100 through D-105, C-100, A-101, A-102, A-105. Architect/Engineer of record: Bowman, Foster & Assoc. Consulting Engineers, 4379 Center Dr., Norfolk, VA 23502. Applicable codes block references NFPA, MIL-HDBK-1191, UBC 1997, ASHRAE, NFPA 70 (NEC), JCAHO standards, WRAMC Construction Safety Policy, DA PAM 40-50-3 (Army Industrial Hygiene), OSHA, USACE CEGS sections, IBC, UFC 4.510.01 (Design Guide for Built Environment of Behavioral Health Facilities) — the JCAHO and UFC 4.510.01 references confirm a healthcare/clinic occupancy. Project description block states: 'The objective of this project is for the contractor to provide all labor, materials and equipment necessary to complete a scoping survey and report, prepare a Type III work plan and complete the construction and repair requirements for active duty PEMH renovation, in accordance with all federal, state, and installation codes and laws... to ensure the provision of health services can be adequately provided for the next 20 years. The existing clinic will provide continuing patient care via transition space.' Aerial photograph shows a large two-story masonry building. Sheet is marked AS-BUILT.

sheets.title: ENLARGED FIRST FLOOR DEMOLITION PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Enlarged plan at 3/32"=1'-0" showing the full first floor of Building 9305. Scale indicates a substantial footprint — building appears to be roughly 200+ feet in the long direction based on graphic scale. Building is an H- or E-shaped masonry structure with multiple wings. Work areas called out include: men's bathroom (ref D-101), women's bathroom (ref D-102), former DFAC area (ref D-103), and B-wing entrance (ref D-104). Demolition legend distinguishes total demolition (solid fill) from extents-only (dashed). Multiple demolition callouts throughout first floor. Building appears to be an existing barracks/training/clinic type structure with CMU construction. Sheet marked AS-BUILT.

sheets.title: MENS BATHROOM DEMOLITION PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Detailed plan at 1/2"=1'-0" of the men's bathroom. Existing layout shows: counter-top sinks, toilet partitions, shower stalls (multiple), urinals, and associated plumbing. Demolition notes call for removal of: counter-top sink and faucet, all lavatory/urinal fixtures, accessories (grab bars, dispensers, mirrors), toilet partitions, wall tile and substrate down to studs/CMU, tile curb at showers, shower seat, existing showers and associated plumbing, floor tile. Note 9 states 'EXISTING TO REMAIN FRAME ONLY.' Shows existing shower area to be completely gutted. The bathroom is a group shower/toilet room consistent with a barracks or gymnasium building. Sheet marked AS-BUILT CONDITIONS SHOWN.

sheets.title: WOMENS BATHROOM DEMOLITION PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Detailed plan at 1/2"=1'-0" of the women's bathroom. Similar existing layout to men's: toilet partitions, shower area, plumbing fixtures. Demolition scope mirrors men's bathroom — full gut to studs/CMU. Note 9 calls for removal of existing 3'-0"x7'-0" door. Confirms two separate restrooms being fully renovated. Sheet marked AS-BUILT CONDITIONS SHOWN.

sheets.title: FIRST FLOOR FORMER DFAC DEMOLITION PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Plan at 1/4"=1'-0" showing demolition at the former Dining Facility (DFAC) area on the first floor. Demolition scope is limited: (1) Remove existing 3'-0"x7'-0" door and metal frame; (2) Remove existing stud wall. A partial floor plan is visible. The space is being opened up to allow ADA-compliant ramp installation in this area. Sheet marked AS-BUILT.

sheets.title: B-WING ENTRANCE DEMOLITION PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Plan at 1/4"=1'-0" showing demolition at the B-Wing exterior entrance. Demolition notes: (1) Remove existing concrete stair entrance and prepare for new walkway; (2) Remove existing concrete sidewalk and prepare for new walkway. Shows a small exterior entrance vestibule/stair area to be demolished. This is the exterior work area where a new ADA-compliant 1:20-slope stair and walkway combination is to be installed. Sheet marked AS-BUILT.

sheets.title: SECOND FLOOR DAYROOM DEMOLITION PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Plan at 1/4"=1'-0" showing second floor dayroom demolition. Demolition note: (1) Remove existing metal stud wall and frame opening to receive new 3'-0"x6'-8" door and metal frame. Shows two adjacent rooms on second floor — one wall partition being partially removed to create a door opening, converting a dayroom to provide a second exit and conference use. Sheet marked AS-BUILT CONDITIONS SHOWN. NOTE: Sheet number D-105 is also used on the B-Wing Entrance Demolition Plan (page 6 of PDF — that sheet carries D-105, Sheet 1 of 2 in its title block, but is titled B-WING ENTRANCE DEMOLITION PLANE). The drawing index on G-001 lists D-104 as 'B-WING ENTRANCE DEMOLITION PLAN' and D-105 as 'SECOND FLOOR DAYROOM DEMOLITION PLAN'. The PDF page 6 sheet title block reads D-105 — possible misnumbering or the index lists D-104 for the B-Wing entrance but the rendered sheet for B-Wing carries D-105. Flagged as drawing numbering anomaly.

sheets.title: ADA COMPLIANT CURB RAMP PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Civil sheet showing existing curb/sidewalk demolition and new ADA curb ramp installation at the parking lot corner adjacent to the building. Site plan (NTS aerial photo) shows building location context. Demolition plan shows existing 6" concrete curb and sidewalk to be removed to prepare for new ADA curb ramp, landing, and new curb return. Plan notes: (1) Provide new ADA compliant curb ramp (1:12 slope max); (2) Provide detectable warning surface (truncated domes); (3) Provide new concrete curb to match existing. Sheet marked AS-BUILT.

sheets.title: MENS RESTROOM FIRST FLOOR PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Construction plan at 1/2"=1'-0" for the renovated men's restroom. New layout: multiple new toilet partitions, new ADA water closet with grab bars (~5'-0" wide stall), standard water closets, new urinal, new vitreous china wall-hung lavatories, shower area with new drain. Key plan notes: (1) New cement backer board and wall tile floor-to-ceiling; (2) New toilet partitions; (3) New vitreous china lavatory sinks; (4) New water closets; (5) New ADA water closet with grab bars and toilet accessories; (6) New urinal; (7) Slope floor to new shower drain; (8) New ADA grab bars, seat and shower accessories; (9) Existing 3'-0"x7'-0" wood door and metal frame. Sheet marked AS-BUILT CONDITIONS SHOWN.

sheets.title: WOMENS RESTROOM FIRST FLOOR PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Construction plan at 3/8"=1'-0" for the renovated women's restroom. New layout shows: ADA water closet with grab bars, standard water closets, new vitreous china wall-hung lavatories, shower area with new drain. Same plan notes as A-101 except no urinal. Scale difference from A-101 (3/8" vs 1/2") suggests women's restroom is somewhat smaller. Dimensions show ~4'-2" and 3'-0" clearances at fixtures. Sheet marked AS-BUILT CONDITIONS SHOWN.

sheets.title: SECOND FLOOR DAYROOM PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Construction plan at 1/4"=1'-0" for the second floor dayroom area. New wall construction: 5/8" gypsum board and 3-5/8" metal stud with sound batt insulation, 6" above ceiling grid. Dimension shows 6'-2-1/4" wall length. Plan notes: (1) Install new wall with sound batt insulation; (2) Provide and install existing 3'-0"x6'-8" wood door and metal frame; (3) Provide and install new ceiling grid and acoustical tile as required. Confirms second floor work is limited to partition/door addition and minor ceiling/ACT work. Sheet marked AS-BUILT CONDITIONS SHOWN.
